boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct University of Miami library study environments, spanning collaborative areas, quiet floors, stack-tower seating, and specialty collections.

cards.entity_name: Otto G. Richter Library First Floor
cards.title: Richter Library First Floor
cards.subtitle: Collaborative study and computing area
cards.notes: Set up here for collaborative coursework or computer-based tasks; keep conversations considerate because this floor is not a designated quiet zone.
cards.short_summary: A central-library floor for collaborative work and general computing.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Libraries identifies Richter Library's first floor for general computing, collaborative work, and group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Study Zones | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Richter Library; use the library's current operating hours and observe the zoned-noise policy.

cards.entity_name: Otto G. Richter Library Second Floor
cards.title: Richter Library Second Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet individual-study floor
cards.notes: Choose an individual seat for focused reading or writing, silence your phone, and reserve any needed group room separately from the quiet floor.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Richter floor with individual study and limited computing.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Libraries designates the entire Richter Library second floor as a quiet zone except for its group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Study Zones | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: Quiet-zone expectations apply; group study rooms are the stated exception.

cards.entity_name: Otto G. Richter Library Stack Tower Floor 4
cards.title: Richter Stack Tower, Floor 4
cards.subtitle: Quiet individual study beside A, PQ7298–PZ, Q–QG, and Z materials
cards.notes: Use this stack-tower floor for individual work near its assigned collections, with your phone silenced and conversation kept to a minimum.
cards.short_summary: A quiet stack-tower study floor paired with humanities and science call-number ranges.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Libraries lists Richter Stack Tower floor 4 for quiet individual study and assigns several call-number ranges to that floor.
cards.source_title: Richter Library Stack Tower Guide | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: The Stack Tower is a quiet zone; follow library noise guidance while using individual seating.

cards.entity_name: Otto G. Richter Library Stack Tower Floor 5
cards.title: Richter Stack Tower, Floor 5
cards.subtitle: Quiet individual study beside JX–JZ, K, L, N, and P–PQ7297 materials
cards.notes: Bring a reading list and settle into individual work near the floor’s law, social-science, language, and literature shelving ranges.
cards.short_summary: A quiet stack-tower floor alongside multiple social-science and humanities collections.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Libraries lists Richter Stack Tower floor 5 for quiet individual study and assigns JX–JZ, K, L, N, and P–PQ7297 materials there.
cards.source_title: Richter Library Stack Tower Guide | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: The Stack Tower is a quiet zone; follow library noise guidance while using individual seating.

cards.entity_name: Otto G. Richter Library Stack Tower Floor 6
cards.title: Richter Stack Tower, Floor 6
cards.subtitle: Quiet individual study beside F2200–FZ, G, H, J–JV, and Juvenile materials
cards.notes: Use the individual-study setting when working through sources from the floor’s history, geography, social-science, or juvenile collections.
cards.short_summary: A quiet stack-tower floor with history, geography, and social-science holdings nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Libraries lists Richter Stack Tower floor 6 for quiet individual study and assigns F2200–FZ, G, H, J–JV, and Juvenile materials there.
cards.source_title: Richter Library Stack Tower Guide | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: The Stack Tower is a quiet zone; follow library noise guidance while using individual seating.

cards.entity_name: Otto G. Richter Library Stack Tower Floor 7
cards.title: Richter Stack Tower, Floor 7
cards.subtitle: Quiet individual study beside B–BF311.O, C, D, E, and F1–F2199 materials
cards.notes: Use this quiet stack floor for sustained individual work, especially when your research draws on its philosophy, history, or geography ranges.
cards.short_summary: A quiet stack-tower floor adjacent to philosophy and history collections.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Libraries lists Richter Stack Tower floor 7 for quiet individual study and assigns B–BF311.O, C, D, E, and F1–F2199 materials there.
cards.source_title: Richter Library Stack Tower Guide | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: The Stack Tower is a quiet zone; follow library noise guidance while using individual seating.

cards.entity_name: Otto G. Richter Library Stack Tower Floor 9
cards.title: Richter Stack Tower, Floor 9
cards.subtitle: Quiet individual study beside B–BF311.O and QH–Z materials
cards.notes: Plan a focused solo session near the floor’s psychology, science, technology, and bibliography holdings; keep devices on silent or vibrate.
cards.short_summary: A quiet stack-tower floor near psychology, science, and technology materials.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Libraries lists Richter Stack Tower floor 9 for quiet individual study and assigns B–BF311.O and QH–Z materials there.
cards.source_title: Richter Library Stack Tower Guide | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: The Stack Tower is a quiet zone; follow library noise guidance while using individual seating.

cards.entity_name: Graduate Student Study Room, Richter Library Room 212
cards.title: Graduate Student Study Room 212
cards.subtitle: Richter Library second floor, northwest corner
cards.notes: Eligible graduate students can check out a carrel key card or lounge access card at Circulation, then use tables, carrels, computers, lockers, and printing.
cards.short_summary: An access-controlled graduate study room with carrels, tables, computers, lockers, and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: Richter Library Room 212 has 22 daily-checkout carrels, 12 study tables, computers, lockers, lounge chairs, and a printer/scanner/copier for eligible graduate students.
cards.source_title: Graduate Student Study Room | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: Exclusive to specified graduate students from the Gables and RSMAS campuses; access is arranged through the Richter Circulation Desk.

cards.title: Architecture Research Center
cards.subtitle: Paul Buisson Architecture Library
cards.notes: Book a study table or room up to one day ahead, or use the quiet library areas; keep drinks covered and leave food outside.
cards.short_summary: An architecture-library setting with bookable tables and rooms plus quiet study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Architecture Research Center offers rooms and study tables for booking, and University of Miami Libraries designates its non-seminar-room areas for quiet study.
cards.source_title: Room & Equipment Reservations | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: Study rooms and tables are bookable through the Library Calendar System; bookings may be made up to one day ahead.

cards.entity_name: Marta and Austin Weeks Music Library
cards.title: Weeks Music Library
cards.subtitle: At the edge of Lake Osceola on the Coral Gables campus
cards.notes: Use a quiet or low-level collaborative seat for research, then draw on the library’s playback equipment and computers when your project needs media tools.
cards.short_summary: A music-focused library with study seating, playback equipment, and research computers.
cards.evidence_claim: Weeks Music Library provides playback equipment, research computers, and quiet, comfortable places to study; its policy permits low-level collaborative conversation.
cards.source_title: Welcome to Weeks Music Library | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: Food and drink are not allowed; low-level, non-disruptive conversation is permitted under the library's noise policy.
